name: Reminiscence in the Night
source:
"Everything stays but it still changes."

You're trapped in your apartment. You have no memory of your past.

As you try to escape, you rapidly understand that you must confront your traumas and the only way to do this is to let your choices guide you in order to be free.

Reminiscence in the Night is an interactive visual novel focused on the theme of lost memories and how our daily choices can help us cope with them.

[From [url=https://team-soletude.itch.io/reminiscencenight]itch.io[/url]]
